name: SlideShowTransition
description: Contains information about how the specified slide advances during a slide show.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).SlideShowTransition

    .Speed = ppTransitionSpeedFast

    .EntryEffect = ppEffectStripsDownLeft

    .SoundEffect.ImportFromFile "c:\sndsys\bass.wav"

    .AdvanceOnTime = True

    .AdvanceTime = 5

End With

ActivePresentation.SlideShowSettings.AdvanceMode = _

    ppSlideShowUseSlideTimings

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: AdvanceOnClick
properties.description: Determines whether the specified slide advances when it is clicked during a slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: AdvanceOnTime
properties.description: Determines whether the specified slide advances automatically after a specified amount of time has elapsed. Read/write.

properties.name: AdvanceTime
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of time, in seconds, after which the specified slide transition will occur. Read/write.

properties.name: EntryEffect
properties.description: Returns or sets the special effect applied to the specified slide transition. Read/write.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Determines whether the specified slide is hidden during a slide show. Read/write.

properties.name: LoopSoundUntilNext
properties.description: Specifies whether the sound that's been set for the specified slide transition loops until the next sound starts. Read/write.

properties.name: SoundEffect
properties.description: Returns a SoundEffect object that represents the sound to be played during the transition to the specified slide. Read-only.

properties.name: Speed
properties.description: Represents the speed of the transition to the specified slide. Read/write.

properties.name: Duration
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of an animation in seconds. Read/write.
